The midterms whitewash is proof that even in the US, Trump’s support has collapsed. He is now defeated, dangerous and a lame-duck President.
ThePrint Editor-In-Chief Shekhar Gupta explains what Trump’s setback means for India, West Asia and the world, and why we must brace for two years of greater anxiety.
